rationale: The Lean declaration correctly encodes an exact algebraic expansion of a parametrized finite matrix product: its first-order recurrence reproduces the paper's single-insertion order after reindexing. It nevertheless changes the sourced result in three consequential ways. It is not linked to computed normalized Householder transformations or Model 1.5, it replaces the unspecified matrix-valued O(u^2) remainder by an unbounded explicit vector state, and it omits the Q^T/F_j form in (4.8)-(4.9). Because neither complete statement implies the other, the appropriate classification is not-faithful-different.
